title.narrative: RAISE SRHR - Regional Access and Accountability for Increased SRHR Equity in East and Southern Africa

description.narrative: The RAISE SRHR is a regional initiative designed to strengthen accountability for Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR) commitments across East and Southern Africa. The project aims to improve the availability, quality, harmonization, and use of SRHR data, while expanding the role of civil society in monitoring progress towards SDG-linked SRHR targets. The initiative takes a regional approach, working in partnership with the secretariats of the East African Community (EAC) and the Southern African Development Community (SADC), national SRHR/RMNCAH managers, and strategic information focal persons from EAC Partner States and SADC Member States. It also engages regional civil society organizations and networks representing rural communities, people living in conflict-affected areas, persons with disabilities, LGBT+ communities, and people living with HIV/AIDS. Implementing partners include APHRC, CHAI, and 2gether 4 SRHR (UNAIDS, UNFPA, UNICEF, and WHO), with the EAC and SADC Parliamentary Forum (SADC-PF) Secretariats serving as coordinating partners. APHRC's role encompasses providing research expertise, strengthening partners' capacity to analyze and use routine SRHR data, and monitoring SRHR commitments. Implemented under the EU-supported Team Europe Initiative (TEI) on SRHR, the project supports countries and regional institutions to transition from fragmented, infrequent data use towards real-time, evidence-informed decision-making and accountability. The program runs from 25 November 2025 to 25 May 2028.
